facts.fact: David 醒来见屏幕上的 Erin 说「I died so young」
facts.anchor: “I know why I made that episode now,” the Erin on the screen said from beneath static. “I died so young. I should have been so much more…”

facts.fact: 分身独白「My life…a bottle of anxiety…Alone, under the stars, lost somewhere in the cinematic universe…」
facts.anchor: “My life,” Erin said from the TV. “My whole entire life. I was just a speck. A bottle of anxiety and emotions.

facts.fact: Mary 对 HBO 回忆 David 脖子上的淤青（fresh/bruises/struggle）
facts.anchor: “I remember the bruises on his neck,” she said to HBO. “They looked fresh, like there had been a struggle.

facts.fact: David 在舞会体育馆感到 seasick、像在风暴中的大船上
facts.anchor: David stumbled between the gyrating masses, feeling seasick, as if the gymnasium was a big ship on the ocean, lurching and wobbling with the waves of a terrible storm.

facts.fact: 足球场尽头 Captain Video 视频店在球门后成形
facts.anchor: Here it was for real, finally looming beyond the goalpost, out in the woods past the end zone.

facts.fact: Erin 平静告别 "I'm not really here. I never was."
facts.anchor: “David,” she said. Her voice was calm. “It’s okay. I get it now. I’m not really here. I never was.”

facts.fact: 门铃响、video store 门开、宇宙吸尘器把 Erin 卷走；Captain Video swallowed her quickly
facts.anchor: Captain Video swallowed her quickly. David tried to follow her, but by the time he got to the end zone, the door to the video store was slamming shut.

facts.fact: Erin 最后念头：Was any of this even real? Had she ever even been anyone at all?
facts.anchor: Was any of this even real? Had she ever even been anyone at all?

facts.fact: David 当夜从阁楼搬下旧 CRT 电视开始一生守静电的仪式
facts.anchor: Later that night, David started a new ritual, one that would stay with him for years to come.
